annotation.title_clean: Komisia uverejňuje usmernenia k vymedzeniu systému umelej inteligencie s cieľom uľahčiť uplatňovanie pravidiel prvého aktu o umelej inteligencii
annotation.title_en: Commission publishes guidelines on the definition of an AI system to facilitate the application of the first rules of the AI Act
annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Commission, Directorate-General for Communications Networks, Content and Technology (Digital Strategy)
annotation.summary_en: Slovak-language European Commission web page announcing the publication of non-binding guidelines on the definition of an AI system under the EU AI Act, released alongside guidelines on prohibited AI practices, and listing downloadable language versions. The first AI Act rules began applying on 2 February 2025.
key_provisions_or_claims: Commission published guidelines on the AI system definition to help providers determine whether software is an AI system.
The guidelines are non-binding and will be updated based on practical experience.
Published alongside guidelines on prohibited AI practices.
First AI Act rules, including AI system definition, AI literacy and prohibitions, applied from 2 February 2025.
AI Act classifies systems into prohibited, high-risk and transparency-obligation categories.
